final_claim: For each n>=1, a fixed positional pair-query support S is VC-shattered by Av_n(231) if and only if no two edges have the same smaller left endpoint. The full support polynomial is product_{j=1}^{n-1}(1+j z), with unsigned Stirling coefficients, (n-1)! facets, n! supports, and VC dimension n-1. Published finite online dimensions and immediate amplification are credited and excluded from the repaired novelty claim.
